title: Delayed Blow-up in 3D Fluids via Pseudo-transport Noise
summary: We establish scaling limit results for fluid dynamics equations driven by pseudo-transport noise. The behaviour of noise at small scales is governed by a parameter a. This extends previous results by Flandoli and Luo (2020) and Galeati (2020), which correspond to a=0 in our setting. Depending on the value of a, we prove that the noise delays the potential blow-up of both the 3D Euler and Navier-Stokes (NS) equations with high probability.
